applies_why: The judge text resolves a collision between the defender's and challenger's chains over the Acts 2:30 loins/seed row.
quote: [CR2] and [CR3] answered the loins/seed row with Genesis 46:26 and Hebrews 7:10 (loins at depth) and the legal/flesh distinction, while [DR3] presses that the only named Davidic man is Joseph; neither chain forces the other.
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
why: The judge compared the two chains as wholes and found neither controlling, rather than requiring a single contrary verse or applying the retired stating-verse test.
